fileheader.author: OpenAI draft model for JSBSim evaluation
fileheader.description: Initial 2 kg lift-plus-cruise eVTOL model. Four DJI E305/9450 lift units, one disabled pusher unit, a conventional fixed wing and tail, and a JSBSim-native multicopter autopilot are included.
fileheader.limitation: Aerodynamic tables are preliminary engineering estimates and are not flight-test validated.
Autopilot gains are initial values and require simulation tuning.
The test mission does not use the pusher motor or fixed-wing control surfaces.
